title: 第2章 蓍龟占卜-《我发现了世界BUG》
content:
第(1/3)页

    我这是......

    死了吗？

    这是在哪儿？

    蛇......

    牙印......

    林舒挣扎着从地上坐起来，视线一片混沌。

    他惊魂未定地看着书桌的方向，这才发现，天色已经大亮。

    太阳照进来了......

    这特么是怎么回事？？

    脑中的混沌还未完全消散，林舒警惕地打量着四周----没有任何一处，有蛇的踪迹。

    同样的，他的手臂上也没有被蛇咬过的牙印。

    但自己确实晕倒了----自己晕倒时是晚上8点10分左右，那时候自己刚把视频发给总编。

    现在，聊天框里都还闪着总编的回复----一连串的大拇指，还有夸奖自己做的不错、内容很扎实的语句。

    而现在是早上8点钟。

    也就是说，自己晕倒了12个小时......

    对于一个没有基础疾病、没有疲劳过度、甚至也从来没有过晕厥记录的健康人来说，这本来就很不同寻常。

    那种“蛇”，是真的存在？

    还是说，这也是某种高明的心理暗示？

    应该是后者----准确地说，这两个判断其实并不冲突。

    之前也听说过有一些厉害的催眠师会让人看见幻觉，原理其实不过是利用了一连串强有力的心理暗示。

    而昨天跟徐长顺的对话过程中，他有太多时间，给自己种下这样的心理暗示了。

    不管怎么样，今天还得去找他一趟。

    至少要搞明白，这是一次巧合，还是他真的有能力“刻意而为”。

    这一定会是个......大爆点！

    林舒稍稍放松了几分----他感觉到了危险，但同时也感觉到了机会。

    自己这不是好好的没死吗？

    就算徐长顺真的对自己做了什么，大概率也是没有恶意的吧......

    他揉着眉心，缓缓在桌前坐下。

    微信的聊天框还在闪烁，点开一看，发来消息的除了总编，还有谢雨迟。

    消息发过来的时间是6点......

    两小时之前。

    林舒点开聊天框，谢雨迟的一连串感叹号立刻弹了出来。

    “徐长顺死了！！！！！”

    徐长顺......

    死了？！
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

This is what I am...

Are you dead?

Where is this?

Snake......

Teeth marks......

Lin Shu struggled to sit up from the ground, his vision blurred.

He looked in the direction of the desk in shock, only to realize that it was already dark.

The sun is shining in...

What the hell is going on??

The chaos in his mind had not completely dissipated, and Lin Shu looked around vigilantly - there was no trace of a snake anywhere.

Similarly, there were no bite marks on his arms.

But I did faint—it was around 8:10 pm when I fainted. At that time, I had just sent the video to the editor-in-chief.

Now, the editor-in-chief’s reply is still flashing in the chat box—a series of thumbs up, as well as sentences praising myself for doing well and having solid content.

And it’s 8 o’clock in the morning.

In other words, I fainted for 12 hours...

For a healthy person with no underlying medical conditions, no excessive fatigue, and no record of fainting, this is already very unusual.

Does that kind of "snake" really exist?

Or is this some kind of clever psychological suggestion?

It should be the latter - to be precise, these two judgments do not conflict.

I have heard before that some powerful hypnotists can make people see hallucinations. The principle is actually just using a series of powerful psychological suggestions.

And during the conversation with Xu Changshun yesterday, he had too much time to plant such psychological hints for himself.

No matter what, I have to go find him today.

"At least we have to figure out whether this is a coincidence or whether he really has the ability to "do it on purpose."

This will definitely be a big hit!

Lin Shu relaxed a little - he felt the danger, but at the same time he also felt the opportunity.

Aren’t you fine and not dead?

Even if Xu Changshun really did something to him, there was a high probability that it was not malicious...

He rubbed his brows and slowly sat down at the table.

The WeChat chat box was still flashing. When I opened it, I saw that in addition to the editor-in-chief, there was also Xie Yuchi who sent the message.

The time the message was sent was 6 o'clock...

Two hours ago.

Lin Shu clicked on the chat box, and a series of exclamation marks from Xie Yuchi popped up immediately.

“Xu Changshun is dead!!!!!”

Xu Changshun......

Dead?!
